concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a premium photorealistic desktop interface concept for a NEW tab called "Эскиз" in the existing Russian local Kanban app "Моя доска". Input image is an EDIT TARGET for the board shell and a reference for material identity. Keep its straight-on front view, thin genuine brushed aluminum frame, white glazed enamel, Cyrillic handwritten felt-tip typography and physical lower pen tray. Replace ALL Kanban columns, task cards, task filters, search, counters and add-task controls with a large freehand drawing workspace. This is a polished believable web-app UI, not an office photo or a computer in a room. Board fills frame, no laptop hardware, no hands, no people.
Header: small hand-drawn board icon then "Моя доска", followed by three navigation tabs "Доска", "Сегодня", "Эскиз". Only "Эскиз" is underlined twice in blue marker. At upper right hand-drawn sun and moon, small settings icon. Beneath header a delicate irregular divider. Minimal drawing toolbar: dark blue, black, red, green ink dots; three stroke-width samples, hand-drawn undo and redo icons. Every interface label and icon must look hand-drawn with a real marker, not typeset UI or vector precision.
LEFT EDGE: a realistic charcoal-gray felt magnetic whiteboard eraser, rounded rectangular body, textured felt edge, understated gray grip, magnetically attached vertically just inside the left frame. Soft contact shadow shows actual thickness. It is the SAME eraser seen in the reference, relocated from bottom tray to left edge. A faint marker outline indicates its home position. Never duplicate the eraser. Keep this narrow strip separate from the main drawing.
Main canvas: generous breathing room with a modest natural freehand system analyst sketch. Across middle: three slightly irregular blue rounded rectangles labelled "Клиент", "API", "Сервис", connected by imperfect blue hand-drawn arrows; small hand-drawn database cylinder below the third labelled "База". In top left of drawing handwritten "Идея процесса" with loose underline. In lower half a simple hand-drawn screen wireframe and a red circled "Уточнить" with a curved arrow to one of its fields. Lines have authentic dry-erase marker ink texture, overlaps darker, varied pressure, subtly imperfect strokes, crisp legible labels. No perfect CAD shapes, no sticky notes. Preserve substantial blank enamel so this looks like an unfinished working sketch, not a crowded infographic.
Bottom tray: three realistic horizontal dry-erase markers, blue, black and red caps, accurate plastic material and small shadows. Small quiet handwritten "Сохранено" near lower right, and a small outlined "Отменить" control may appear only for clearing state.
Materials: highly convincing brushed metal, enamel microtexture and reflected broad light, physical felt and plastic. DO NOT paint the board or eraser as cartoons. Reflected window must be very faint, defocused and diffuse, consistent with enamel rather than a mirror. All text Russian and correctly spelled. Landscape image, high detail, product mockup quality.
VARIANT: DAY / normal drawing state. Bright soft daylight, faint washed-out window/green foliage reflection at far left only. Main drawing in blue with restrained red annotations, black wireframe. Eraser parked at left. Near eraser a small tasteful handwritten hover tooltip on an ivory paper slip, text exactly "Нажать — очистить всё" and below "Потянуть — стереть часть". This tooltip must be readable but unobtrusive. Main focus the inviting drawing surface. Wide 16:10 composition.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high fidelity photorealistic interaction storyboard for the new "Эскиз" tab of the attached Russian whiteboard app. The input is a material/style reference: genuine white enamel board, slim aluminum frame, naturally handwritten navy marker labels. Design ONE wide presentation composed of THREE clearly separated horizontally aligned equal panels, each a close-up of the same board, NO device frames or hands. Larger typography, minimal enough to read. A short handwritten caption OUTSIDE each panel: "1. Потянуть", "2. Отпустить", "3. Нажать". All captions and UI handwritten, no modern typed UI.
Panel 1: locally erasing a sketch. Left board edge with an EMPTY faint dashed rectangular dock outline for the eraser. The ONE photorealistic gray felt eraser has been lifted from this left dock and is now hovering over a blue freehand rectangle and arrow in the middle; a small realistic white hand cursor grabs it. A clean swath interrupts only the ink below the eraser, with subtle residual wipe smudge at boundary; the rest of the drawn diagram is fully intact. A very subtle dashed movement arrow from dock to eraser shows path. Below tiny handwritten explanation "Стираем только под губкой".
Panel 2: button released. The same eraser returned to its left magnetic dock, with a faint short return-direction arrow. Remaining diagram retains exactly the same partial gap as panel1, the unaffected shapes still visible, NO full clearing. Small text "Губка вернулась на место". One eraser only.
Panel 3: clicking the docked eraser clears all drawing. The eraser is still attached to left edge, cursor clicking it, surrounding canvas clean. Header and tools remain unaffected. Bottom a small paper-colored message with text "Эскиз очищен" and underlined blue "Отменить". Small caption "Один клик — чистая доска". This Undo must be clearly visible, no confirmation dialog.
Each board panel includes a small top navigation "Доска  Сегодня  Эскиз" with Эскиз underlined blue. Natural bright daylight, very soft enamel reflections, physical eraser felt detail and contact shadows. No cards, no Kanban columns, no blackboard, no hands/people, no shiny mirror reflections, no vector/cartoon eraser. This is an interaction design proposal, not code. Crisp Russian lettering and clear storytelling. Landscape 3:2 or 16:9 presentation.

final_cleanup_for_day_and_evening: Use case: precise-object-edit. This rendered UI is the EDIT TARGET. Keep EVERYTHING exactly the same: full composition, all Russian text, drawings, colors, lighting, thin metal frame, docked realistic eraser at upper left, marker pens, toolbars and reflections. Make ONLY these two small cleanup edits: (1) Remove the EMPTY DASHED VERTICAL RECTANGLE visible farther down the left margin below the eraser, seamlessly restore enamel in that small area. There is only one magnetic home for the eraser and it is already occupied at upper left, so no second dock/placeholder should be drawn. Do not remove or move the actual eraser. (2) Remove the lower-right outlined button labelled "Отменить" from this NORMAL drawing state; keep the handwritten "Сохранено" status in place. Undo/redo arrows in the top toolbar remain unchanged. Preserve all other pixels and elements as closely as possible. Do not add anything.
